title: juniperus communis var. vulgaris
intro: Juniperus communis var. vulgaris, commonly known as common juniper, is a shrub-like evergreen plant that belongs to the cypress family. The health benefits of common juniper include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve urinary tract issues, and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of common juniper include terpenes, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
